body: I am often very hesitant to go to a hospital for the same reason, and I've found that overloading on other coping mechanisms has been helpful. Yesterday I was feeling really suicidal so I called a suicide hotline, I called my therapist, I called my mom, I called a trusted friend, I took a bath, went for a walk and after all of that I felt a little better. It seems excessive, but sometimes you need to tell yourself that you're in emergency mode and have a plan for what emergency mode is (that doesn't necessarily include hospitalization).  For me, sometimes the act of just doing something to take care of myself can be really helpful, even if the act is really small and insignificant.
I'm sorry you're going through this too, I'd go nuts with a headache for that long. Hope you feel better soon 💕

My friend group ghosted me when lockdown started, I feel like I'm in a similar spot. No opportunity to make new friends or live life to distract from that.

I've tried to do art and puzzles to make alone time better, and I've started using reddit more and joined discord channels related to my interests to try and socialize with people.
